foundations.rationale: The About cards explain implemented systems and acknowledge model limits; the owner-selected width schematic is documented without institutional claims.

copy.rationale: About Gradient states 21 equal cells, halving ink area, 20 stops and 1 to 1/1,048,576 represented light. It explicitly warns that steps disappear at screen resolution and that this is not a calibrated brightness chart. Other requested copy and credits are preserved.

interface.rationale: Gradient stays Static with no motion/GIF controls. Both layouts and historical motion restores remain static. Chromium/WebKit keyboard, 390px layout, reset/randomize/Undo and actual SVG/PNG download checks pass. No changed font, palette or new UI asset is introduced; the About copy explains the finite-resolution behavior.

bar-and-exports.rationale: The owner requested implementation of a scientifically direct geometric encoding after the soft-logarithmic candidate was distinguished from a dynamic-range target. Twenty-one equal cells encode I[n]/I[0] = 2^-n through actual ink area. Both variants have exact normalized 2:1 successive area ratios and a 1,048,576:1 span. No logarithmic transform, minimum-width inflation, edge paint, fitted spacing or emitted-brightness claim remains. Preview/header/SVG/PNG/Home use the same static geometry; legacy motion remains ignored and GIF unavailable.

media.rationale: Read all contextual media sources. Only two existing Gradient SVG samples and original application review captures change. No production video, photo, audio, seal or spirit mark is introduced; their permissions and video typography conflict remain outside this change.

assets-and-approvals.rationale: Read asset_licensing.md and its actual unresolved permission records. Gradient samples are original software-authored rectangles, not copied Xyla artwork. Screenshots reuse existing project assets. No fonts, logos, external artwork or licenses are added or replaced; existing redistribution questions remain open.

governance.rationale: Read all 17 captured pages and source coverage/manifest. Record the owner’s narrowly scoped November 18 product decision in brand_conflicts.md without altering official sources, checks or claiming formal approval.

existingConflicts.disposition: B01 retains formal institutional-review questions. The final scientific implementation request supersedes the earlier logarithmic-display candidate: 21 equal cells directly encode light ratios with halving ink area and explicit raster/brightness limitations. See the appended decision note. Other B01–B10 approval, geometry, palette and asset boundaries remain unchanged.

approvalRationale: Owner-authorized numerical encoding uses static single-ink primitive geometry without new assets, palette, calibration claims or organizational lockups. Existing formal RPI approval questions remain open.
